empty.heading: No curriculum yet
empty.body: Nothing has been planned for this mission. One press and an agent maps it into modules, fundamentals first, with every lesson named up front.
empty.then: It writes the plan and no lessons — you ask for those one at a time afterwards.

module.noOutcome: The curriculum didn't record an outcome for this module.

lesson.fundamental: {count, plural, one {# lesson builds on this} other {# lessons build on this}}

outcomes.unrecorded: {count, plural, one {# finished with no outcome} other {# finished with no outcome}}

mission.notPlanned: {count, plural, one {# module has no lessons planned yet, so it is not in this count} other {# modules have no lessons planned yet, so they are not in this count}}

adjustment.bridgeUnnamed: A smaller step toward an earlier lesson
adjustment.harder: Pitched a step above the plan

upcoming.bridge: The next lesson will be a smaller step toward {title}, because it landed too hard.
upcoming.harder: The next lesson will be pitched a step harder: {a} and {b} both landed too easy.

exam.afterLessons: Exam: written once every lesson here is done.
exam.notWritten: Exam: not written yet. Ask for the next thing and it will be.
exam.noItems: Exam: written, with nothing in it to pass.
exam.notSat: {total, plural, one {Exam: # item, not sat yet.} other {Exam: # items, not sat yet.}}
exam.passed: {total, plural, one {Exam passed: # of # item.} other {Exam passed: all # items.}}
exam.selfReported: {count, plural, one {# of those passes is self-reported.} other {# of those passes are self-reported.}}

deadline.moveHint: The date you first committed to stays on screen.
deadline.proposed: Proposed from your pace: {date}. Change it if you know better.
deadline.noEstimate: There's no estimate yet, so pick the date yourself.
deadline.met: {count, plural, =0 {Finished on its deadline, {date}.} one {Finished # day before its deadline, {date}.} other {Finished # days before its deadline, {date}.}}
deadline.missed: {count, plural, one {Finished # day after its deadline, {date}.} other {Finished # days after its deadline, {date}.}}
deadline.overdue: {count, plural, one {Due {date}. # day past it, and not finished.} other {Due {date}. # days past it, and not finished.}}
deadline.onTrack: {count, plural, one {Due {date}, in # day. At your pace the exam lands on {projected}.} other {Due {date}, in # days. At your pace the exam lands on {projected}.}}
deadline.behind: {count, plural, one {Due {date}, in # day. At your pace the exam lands on {projected}, {behind, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} late.} other {Due {date}, in # days. At your pace the exam lands on {projected}, {behind, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} late.}}
deadline.noProjection: {count, plural, one {Due {date}, in # day. No projection to compare it with yet.} other {Due {date}, in # days. No projection to compare it with yet.}}
deadline.moved: {count, plural, one {First committed for {first}, and moved once.} other {First committed for {first}, and moved # times.}}

projection.afterUnplanned: No projection: an earlier module has no lessons planned yet.

schedule.heading: Schedule
schedule.basis: {count, plural, one {Projected from {minutes} minutes a lesson (# timed lesson) and {perDay} minutes a day on this mission over the last {days} days. Each exam counts as one more lesson.} other {Projected from {minutes} minutes a lesson (the median of # timed lessons) and {perDay} minutes a day on this mission over the last {days} days. Each exam counts as one more lesson.}}
schedule.needsTimedLessons: {count, plural, =0 {They need three finished lessons with focus time on them, and there are none yet.} one {They need three finished lessons with focus time on them, and there is #.} other {They need three finished lessons with focus time on them, and there are #.}}
schedule.needsRecentTime: They also need some focus time on this mission in the last 28 days.
